articles.summary: Most health systems benchmark rates only when a contract comes up for renewal. Learn how leading organizations use continuous market intelligence and monthly price transparency data to strengthen negotiations year-round.

articles.title: Why Most Pricing Data Gives You Half the Picture—And How We Fixed That
